solver_note: Gurobi is requested first on every solve, but refuses the study-scale models: "Model too large for size-limited license". This container carries only the pip size-limited Gurobi licence (2000 variables / 2000 constraints) and every model here is far larger, so those solves fall back to HiGHS (open-source MILP, driven through the same Pyomo interface). Re-run with a full Gurobi licence to use Gurobi throughout.
